card.text: A cool T6 brown dwarf of 53 Jupiter masses, circling its sibling Ba every 11 years.

sources.label: McCaughrean et al. 2004
sources.quote: have spectral types of T1 and T6, respectively

introduction.text: Epsilon Indi Bb is the cooler of the two brown dwarfs far out from Epsilon Indi A. Ten years of VLT images traced its whole orbit around Ba.

sources.label: Chen et al. 2022
sources.quote: Relative astrometry with NACO fully constrains the Keplerian orbit of the binary pair

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A sphere of the model radius, glowing with its own heat. No surface, colour or spin is measured.
